reservation: Next two lexicographic unused IDSSE IDs, before development diagnostics or candidate results. Local JSON/report inventory and downloaded-file inventory contain no prior use. Their tracking and labels have not been downloaded. Download and verify published hashes only if a candidate qualifies; never substitute consumed games.

hypothesis: Short proximity to an opponent is weaker evidence of controlled possession than persistent proximity. Test bounded temporal support without player identities or invented relative velocities.

diagnostic_definitions.matching: Unchanged official greedy same-team IoU matching at 0.5 within native metadata periods and known-reference runs.
diagnostic_definitions.likely_split: One reference possession overlaps at least two same-team predictions, each covering at least 10 percent of that reference possession.
diagnostic_definitions.likely_merge: One prediction overlaps at least two same-team reference possessions, each covering at least 10 percent of that prediction.
diagnostic_definitions.wrong_team_overlap: Frames with opposite H/A labels; possession count is references containing at least one such frame.
diagnostic_definitions.missing_ball: Nonfinite or implausibly outside normalised ball position, as defined by the existing model; never target-dependent.
diagnostic_definitions.suppressed_correct_geometry: Reference H/A, geometry sign supports reference, decoded label differs. Descriptive association, not proof of decoder causality.
diagnostic_definitions.selected_wrong_geometry: Reference H/A, geometry sign opposes reference and decoded label equals that opposite team.
diagnostic_definitions.boundary_error: Signed prediction minus reference start/end on official IoU-0.5 matched possessions only; report sample count.
diagnostic_definitions.stoppage: Missed/false D frame counts and D-interval IoU-0.5 matching; restart errors use official to-typed transition pairs at 12 frames.
diagnostic_definitions.caveat: Categories overlap; they do not partition FP/FN or establish physical causes. Raw timelines remain local.

candidate_specification: To be fixed after baseline-only development diagnosis and before candidate scores; no grid search.
timing: One warm-up per profile, three alternating measured runs per profile; loading excluded. Whole-CLI timing separately if promoted.
stopping_rule: One candidate only. If any development gate fails, reject promotion and leave reserved final data unopened. Otherwise freeze source/configuration/input hashes, score both fixed methods once on both new final matches, and apply the same gates. No retuning or gate relaxation after scores.
limitations: Engineering gates, not official rules or statistical significance. Same-provider corrected multicamera observations do not establish transfer to competition tracking. No competition reference or consumed final results may guide design.
